source.title: WCA Quality Assurance Committee Leader Announcement (December 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Sarah Strong will become the new Leader of the WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC). Sarah was already working as a Senior Member of the WQAC.

Sarah was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of December 10, 2025.

We thank Deni Mintsaev, who will remain as a senior member of the WQAC, for the work he has done as the Leader, and wish Sarah the best of luck in fulfilling her new duties.

Sarah was one of the two applications we received. You can view all the candidacy documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yvHLGrbrL67En-706c9nOOgVrB6-4Gql?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 质量保证委员会负责人任命公告（2025 年 12 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Sarah Strong 将出任 WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）负责人。Sarah 此前已是 WQAC 高级成员。

根据关于 WCA 委员会与团队的[决议](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节，WCA 董事会选定 Sarah，并经投票通过。任命自 2025 年 12 月 10 日起生效。

感谢 Deni Mintsaev 在负责人任内所做的工作。他将继续担任 WQAC 高级成员。祝 Sarah 在新岗位上一切顺利。

本次共收到两份申请，Sarah 是其中一位申请人。全部申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yvHLGrbrL67En-706c9nOOgVrB6-4Gql?usp=sharing)查看。
